comments: Input facts: ego and agent1 are cars; ego initiates lateral incursion and agent1 responds; both initially travel in different lanes of the same trafficway. Chosen assumptions: a compact urban two-lane corridor; a faster agent1 approaches on ego left. Ego cuts left after 0.6 s. When ego enters agent1 lane within 14 m, agent1 waits 0.15 s and attempts a right evasive lane change into the lane ego is vacating if clear. This creates intersecting lateral paths instead of the outward escape into a third lane. Speeds are m/s, distances are m, and times are s. Collision is not required.
